evidence.title: README.md
evidence.locator: Features; CLI Commands; Remote Instance Management; Security Model
evidence.finding: Terminal orchestrator runs named coding CLIs against prd.json/Beads tasks. It offers PRD generation, persisted sessions, progress memory, subagent tracing, headless execution and authenticated remote control on VPS/CI hosts.

evidence.title: website/content/docs/parallel/overview.mdx
evidence.locator: Parallel execution; Multi-Epic Sessions; What Happens
evidence.finding: Optional parallel workers use task worktrees, a dependency graph, one session branch and serial merge queue, with conflict resolution and backup tags. Default is sequential; external incomplete dependencies block tasks.

evidence.title: website/content/docs/configuration/options.mdx
evidence.locator: Core Settings; Agent Options
evidence.finding: Configurable agent/model/custom command, iteration caps, progress/log paths, optional autoCommit and subagent tracing levels.

evidence.title: website/content/docs/configuration/sandbox.mdx
evidence.locator: Platform Requirements; What It Does Not Protect; Configuration Options
evidence.finding: Opt-in Bubblewrap on Linux or sandbox-exec on macOS; Windows needs WSL2. Configurable writable/read-only paths and network disable. No VM-level boundary or CPU/memory/process limits; auto can fall back off.

evidence.title: Ralph TUI: website/content/docs/getting-started/installation.mdx
evidence.locator: Prerequisites Bun Runtime tabs; global and source installation
evidence.finding: The first-party installation page provides macOS/Linux and native Windows PowerShell Bun setup followed by global ralph-tui installation. The primary product is a terminal CLI/TUI, not a desktop GUI.

evidence.title: Ralph TUI: src/commands/run.tsx
evidence.locator: CLI/TUI command tree, src/tui components, src/parallel/index.ts and remote server
evidence.finding: Bounded inspection of the product command tree, TUI components, parallel executor and remote listener found no browser or native phone client, proposed-code diff review renderer, human team-role/SSO model or product telemetry opt-out setting. ParallelExecutor is a deterministic dependency/worktree worker engine, not an agent coordinator role with delegation tools. The remote listener uses owner/server and connection tokens. Run guidance prints a manual gh pr create command rather than creating a PR itself.

evidence.title: Ralph TUI: src/config/types.ts
evidence.locator: SandboxMode union; src/sandbox/wrapper.ts mode dispatch
evidence.finding: The complete sandbox mode union is auto, bwrap, sandbox-exec and off. The implementation wraps native commands with Linux bubblewrap or macOS sandbox-exec. It does not provision Docker/OCI containers or virtual machines; Git worktrees are separate.

evidence.title: Ralph TUI: website/content/docs/cli/remote.mdx
evidence.locator: Remote Parallel Orchestration; src/remote/server.ts orchestrate:start handler
evidence.finding: The documented remote WebSocket API can programmatically start parallel execution with orchestrate:start, then pause/resume/stop or query it. The product-owned server executes on the remote host and streams events to subscribers. This permits an external program to start work without a human operating the TUI for each run; it does not establish a cron scheduler or distinct human collaboration identities.

evidence.title: Ralph TUI: website/content/docs/plugins/agents/pi.mdx
evidence.locator: Prerequisites provider API keys and No API key configured
evidence.finding: The first-party Pi plugin guide explicitly requires a user API key for at least one provider and names ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and GEMINI_API_KEY. Those provider accounts pay for model use; Ralph TUI remains free MIT software.
